_comment: Display metadata for plugins not yet in registry.json. release.yml falls back to this file on a first tag (<slug>-v<semver>); package.sh then writes the real registry entry and the slug should be removed from here.

automations.name: Automations
automations.description: Declarative trigger → conditions → action rules over kernel events, with cooldowns and a confirmation gate.

capture.name: Capture
capture.description: Screenshots, screen recording and local OCR over PipeWire and tesseract.

contacts.name: Contacts
contacts.description: Contact store (name, email, phone, tags) as a thin schema over database.

github.name: GitHub
github.description: List and create issues, list pull requests and CI runs through the GitHub REST API.

library.name: Library
library.description: Index local music, photos and video under allowlisted roots for search and random picks.

metrics.name: Metrics
metrics.description: Periodic CPU/RAM/disk/battery samples with range queries for graphs.

mqtt.name: MQTT
mqtt.description: MQTT client with device registry, telemetry and OTA for Tasmota/ESPHome/Zigbee2MQTT-style devices.

rss.name: RSS
rss.description: Subscribe to RSS/Atom feeds, fetch and query deduplicated articles.

speech.name: Speech
speech.description: Text-to-speech and speech-to-text in one process: local ONNX (Kokoro/Piper/Zipformer/Whisper) plus cloud providers.

tasks.name: Tasks
tasks.description: To-do list with due dates, lists and tags as a thin schema over database.

telegram.name: Telegram
telegram.description: Telegram user-account client: dialogs, history, search, send/edit/forward, media and voice.

uptime.name: Uptime
uptime.description: Periodic URL health checks with history and failure events for alerting.

weather.name: Weather
weather.description: Current weather and daily forecast from Open-Meteo — no API key.
